subject: scale_y_continuous does not work with polar coordinates

messages.author: 263e2e3754a08c89
messages.subject: scale_y_continuous does not work with polar coordinates
parts:
Hello,


I am trying to resize my polar coordinate graph and have come to the
realization that scale_y_continuous used with limits does not actually
limit the polar coordinate scale. Could this be a bug or is there a
different mechanism to place limits on the "y" scale for a polar plot?

Thanks,

Ben

messages.author: 263e2e3754a08c89
messages.subject: Re: scale_y_continuous does not work with polar coordinates
parts:
library(ggplot2)
mitodata <- data.frame(snp = seq(1,16601,by = 100),p
=sample(seq(0,1,by = 0.001),167,replace = TRUE),race = sample(c(1,2),
167,replace = TRUE))
mitodata$neglogp <- -1*log10(mitodata$p)
mitodata$neglogpline <- -1*log10(0.05)

visibleboundaries <-
c(1,576,1601,3229,4262,5511,7445,8269,9207,9990,10404,10766,12137,14148,14673,15887)
bdries <- data.frame(x = visibleboundaries,y=-.5)
lines <- data.frame(x = seq(0,16567,by=1),y = 0)

wbplot <- ggplot(mitodata, aes(x = snp,y = neglogp)) +
geom_point()+
coord_polar(direction = -1) +
geom_line(aes(x,1.30),color = "red",data = lines) +
geom_point(aes(x,y),data=lines) +
opts(axis.ticks = theme_blank(),legend.position = "none",axis.text.x =
theme_blank(),
axis.text.y = theme_blank(),axis.title.y =
theme_blank(),axis.title.x=theme_blank(),plot.margin =
unit(c(0,0,0,0),"cm")) +
layer(geom="text",mapping =aes(x,y,label = x),data = bdries,size=2.5)
+
annotate("text", x = 6500,y = 1,label = "P=.1",colour = "black",size
=3) +
annotate("text", x = 6500,y = 2,label = "0.01",colour = "black",size =
3) +
annotate("text", x = 6500,y = 3,label = "0.001",colour = "black",size
= 3) +
scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-3,3))

wbplot
